subject_mutation_detail.rule: removed/changed => verdict void; added is recorded, not fatal; an empty side => INCONCLUSIVE (never a clean verdict from nothing)

verdict_adjudication.why: the checker's enforced sandbox is read-only, so it could neither run the harness (which creates files and edits ACLs) nor run its mutation mode; it therefore refused to call it verified. Its refusal is correct behaviour, not a defect.
verdict_adjudication.what_it_did_verify: source-level fail-ability (PASS requires baseline AND denied AND restored AND cleanup); the stored receipt's booleans, including the raw PermissionError stderr of the denied attempt; and independently that the recorded probe path no longer exists.
verdict_adjudication.claim_after_adjudication: the mechanism is DEMONSTRATED by two non-checker executions and its fail-ability is SOURCE-CONFIRMED by the independent checker; an execution BY THE CHECKER ITSELF (or another actor under a write-capable sandbox) remains OPEN
verdict_adjudication.residual: R7-03-ISOLATE independent execution: open (owner-gated OG6 for the non-liftable boundary)

verdict_adjudication.why: the refusal event, the guard predicate's execution, the append-only transcript and the orchestrator's persistence act are historical events that no artifact in this round can authenticate. The dossier records them as reported by the lane.
verdict_adjudication.what_it_did_verify: the dossier does contain the raw refusal error string and does separate 'the lane measured it' from 'the orchestrator persisted it'.
verdict_adjudication.claim_after_adjudication: ARTIFACT-LEVEL CLAIM ONLY: the dossier contains that raw error string and distinguishes the two actors. The historical false-positive and the provenance chain are asserted, not independently authenticated.
verdict_adjudication.residual: the guard false-positive class (OG8) is evidenced, not proven; a runtime-plane owner reproducing it from the guard's own logs would close it

verdict_adjudication.observation: the checker read lane/VERIFY_RECEIPT.json mid-run and saw ok=false with ERR_GUARD_ROOT_MISSING, and correctly declined to treat it as evidence of acceptance.
verdict_adjudication.truth: that was the REFUSED FIRST attempt of this lane, which the successful retry overwrote when it completed its turn. The current on-disk receipt is the successful one.
verdict_adjudication.round_response: the first-fail is preserved at lane/VERIFY_ATTEMPT1_REFUSED.json with its root cause and remediation; it is not deleted or hidden.

round_side_errata.finding: a lane receipt written to a fixed path is overwritten by a retry, destroying the first-fail of the refused attempt.
round_side_errata.evidence: lane/VERIFY_ATTEMPT1_REFUSED.json (preserved from the dispatch output) vs the successful lane/VERIFY_RECEIPT.json
round_side_errata.fix: write an attempt-numbered receipt path or copy the pre-existing receipt aside before retrying

round_side_errata.finding: a guard root that does not yet exist makes the whole dispatch fail closed (ERR_GUARD_ROOT_MISSING, 'a vacuous guard would report a clean subject').
round_side_errata.fix: generate every guard root BEFORE assembling the guard set; a guard on a not-yet-generated artifact is itself a defect the tool refuses to accept

round_side_errata.finding: the round's own openspec tasks.md initially ticked tasks that had not been executed.
round_side_errata.evidence: the file's own correction note; the corrected file leaves unexecuted tasks unticked
round_side_errata.fix: tick only against an artifact that exists; keep the correction note in the file

round_side_errata.finding: the mandate to search-and-reuse produced a contract whose shingle similarity to the prior contract is 0.596, which the compiler's duplication gate flags.
round_side_errata.fix: scope the duplication gate to the EXECUTED prompt rather than the plan contract; the writer brief handed to the lane is newly authored
